name: EPIC 228709393
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 8.5 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,739 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.85 solar masses and 8.5 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,700 K at its surface.
